verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client that could plausibly ship official developer SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of any SDK. The MCP 'Add custom integration' feature is client-side: it connects Shortwave's AI to other servers, which is an adjacent capability. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
